operations.title: An energy-dependent xi boundary is not a self-adjoint operator without positive linearization
operations.statement: An endpoint map depending on the candidate eigenvalue defines a nonlinear pencil, not a fixed self-adjoint domain. A self-adjoint auxiliary linearization requires a source-derived Nevanlinna Weyl function. Any fixed self-adjoint discrete operator whose determinant equals the critical-line normalization of xi would force all xi zeros real and hence prove RH; constructing it diagonally from zeros is circular.
operations.scope: Typing and necessity theorem; neither proves RH nor excludes a source-derived positive Weyl-function realization.

operations.title: Fixed-domain and Nevanlinna linearization gate
operations.description: Distinguish eigenvalue-dependent boundary pencils from fixed extensions and require conjugation symmetry, upper-half-plane positivity, compact resolvent, and exact determinant normalization.

authority_basis.summary: Continue deriving or falsifying a noncircular Mellin boundary with discrete xi spectrum and add the research to the ledger.
